description: This file contains API service functions for fetching and updating network and system status data, including mock data handling for development environment, and functions for various system components like WAN, LAN, WLAN, statistics, Wi-Fi neighbors, NTP, timezone, DDNS, dual image status, and deployment units.

methods.name: getWanStatus
methods.description: Fetches WAN status, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getLanStatus
methods.description: Fetches LAN status, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getWlanStatus
methods.description: Fetches WLAN status, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getStatistics
methods.description: Fetches network statistics, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getWifiNeighbors
methods.description: Fetches Wi-Fi neighbors status, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: scanWifiNeighbors
methods.description: Scans for Wi-Fi neighbors on specified band, returns mock data in development, otherwise performs fetch request.

methods.name: getLcmStatus
methods.description: Fetches LCM deployment status, returns mock data with random deployment units in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: getNtpSettings
methods.description: Retrieves NTP settings, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateNtpSettings
methods.description: Updates NTP settings, returns mock data in development, otherwise performs POST request.

methods.name: getTimezones
methods.description: Retrieves timezone data, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateTimezone
methods.description: Updates timezone data, performs POST request.

methods.name: getDdns
methods.description: Retrieves DDNS data, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.

methods.name: updateDdns
methods.description: Updates DDNS data, performs POST request.

methods.name: getDualImageStatus
methods.description: Fetches dual image status, returns mock data in development, otherwise calls API.
